project_name: RendezVousPro: appointment booking and reminders for private clinics
sector: appointment booking and reminders for private clinics
problem: Private clinics lose between one in five and one in six booked slots to patients who do not show up, and receptionists spend about a third of their day on phone calls to rebook. Most clinics still use a paper diary or a shared WhatsApp number.
solution: web service that lets private clinics in Tunisia take appointments online and send SMS and WhatsApp reminders to patients
competitors:
- paper diary
- general calendar tools
- Doctolib
risks:
- Clinics may be slow to change habits
- Messaging costs depend on mobile operators
- A larger player could enter the market
traction_note: Six clinics in Tunis and Ariana have used the beta for four months. In a sample of 1,900 appointments, the no-show rate fell from 22% to 11%. Of the six beta clinics, five have asked to convert to a paid plan at the end of the trial.
